g.text: SysML interaction INT-01 - grant, data fault and recovery
ACT-08 mark served; advance ring pointer
No new green while grant/clearance is active.
Fallback grant: next eligible in ring, 10 s
[three consecutive new valid frames on distinct ticks]
recoveryStreak; clear fault after third good frame
Sensor clears fault after 3 new good frames.
Controller returns Normal only at next round boundary.
No reset of round or wait timers on mode change.
